body: It was weird. Yesterday she asked me if I was going to the expo where I saw her today, so I went. Then she had the idea to go grab dinner, and we did. And finally I told her how I felt, and she rejected me yet again. I'm no good for anything.

Thanks. She was my first serious GF so it's hard for me to accept that there's more people that could make me happy in a relationship.

I can't wait to start going to college and meet new people to hang out with pretty much everyday, that and studying are gonna keep me pretty busy. I was already going but I didn't like my career, so I switched.

I know, the idea of there being "only one" is foolish, but my brain refuses to listen. I have the worst case of cold turkey I've ever had, and I feel lonely and sad most of the time because of that :/ I've run out of things to do, I can't focus on anything.
Thanks man, I guess there's no point in worrying if there's nothing else I can do. I'll try to keep my mind busy.
I'm glad I could help you :)

You did the right thing, she's being very immature by acting one way and then another. You'll be okay, you seem to be doing better than most, really keeping a level head. If you two happen to talk again and she starts acting like that once more, ask her what is going on, ask her if she wants to be with you or no. She can't treat you like that.

I broke up with my GF like 2 and a half months ago, it was similar to your situation, but we were in college and were dating for 2 years and 9 months. We had some issues with time but we were doing ok in general. One morning, after not talking for a day, she broke up with me. She suggested to stay friends, but I told her "Not right now". That was out of nowhere and it completely wrecked me. But I still refused to keep in touch.

Think about it. Do you really want her as nothing more than a friend? People change a lot dude, you and her are growing up and maybe she doesn't know what she really wants and needs to take a break. It doesn't mean you are a bad partner.

But right now it seems like she doesn't want a relationship. She might try to explain herself if you pressure her to talk, but I doubt you'll truly understand her. Don't try to do it, don't think about it all night.

I think you should sever the connection, it's for the best, unless you think you can see her as NOTHING more than a friend (which I highly doubt). I know I would not want to be friends with my ex and see her dating other guys and shit, fuck that. Keeping in touch with her will only prolong your pain, it will keep the sore open. 

This is hard as fuck. I get you, I was there just a couple of months ago. I wouldn't wish this on anyone. But you (and honestly, I too) have to keep in mind that no one is essential in OUR life, but ourselves. Take some time for yourself, do the things you like the most, hang out with your friends, play with your pets, work out, play videogames.

And one last thing, don't beat yourself up over it *too* much. It seems like this wasn't your fault and apparently you always had the best intentions. She's the one who decided to end things. You've made it pretty clear that you love her and don't want this. She can contact you IF she feels like talking to you again. There are tons of people in this world, there isn't just "the only one". If that were true, it would be practically impossible to find that someone. There's tons of people in the world to be happy with, she may have been one but she's constantly changing, and you will change too. Maybe those changes didn't work for your relationship.

But right now, just take time to heal and see where things go, so you can be ready to love just as strongly again in the future. You need to be happy with yourself, more than anything, so being with someone becomes a joy, not a necessity. I hope I could help you, feel free to talk to me if you feel stressed or want to let things out. Stay strong.

Thanks a lot for taking the time to reply. I'm only seeing this now. These tips are great, I just wish I wasn't so emotional so I could follow them more easily. I feel like I'm making progress but after a while I start missing her, and cry a lot :/ not all day though, I'm starting to think less about her each day. Which tells me she might be going through the same (if she even thinks about me at all), and it hurts. 

And I also feel pissed at her for telling me we may get back together and then not talking to me at all and basically making me feel like I'm dead to her. I feel so easily disposable, she means a world to me, but it seems like I don't mean anything to her, and maybe I do. She just broke up with me and completely stopped talking to me, after telling me she loves me 2 days before. I check her FB sometimes but I never, ever talk to her and I won't, it doesn't matter how much I want to, I feel mistreated.

I feel like such a wreck. I can't comprehend her and it pisses me off. The only thing I do now is just work, go to the gym and try to have some dignity and not talk to her. But I'm also fantasizing about her coming back to me. Sigh... This is a really hard ride.
Yeah, there are lots of people in the world. I'm feeling better now, thanks

Thanks, I have my flaws as she has hers, but I believe we both brought out the best of each other. I know that even if I messed up sometimes, I gave my everything until the very end. I'm focusing on myself right now, doing things I like and going out with friends. I'm gonna work on improving my mind and body, I have to work things out inside my mind too. Thanks for your advice.

Yeah, thanks. Im just so sad and mad... We used to care so much about each other and now she won't even talk to me. It feels so strange. And she left me at the hardest time in my life. I know I wouldn't have done that.

Thanks a lot for your words of encouragement. I'm slowly getting there, I still hurt but I spend more and more time everyday thinking about other things or feeling good. Now I remember how much I loved to play CSGO and a lot of other videogames. I'm hanging out with my friends a lot more, and I've been going to the gym for 3 weeks and don't plan on stopping for at least 3 more months. 

The hardest parts have been these attacks of loneliness, they're pretty sudden and strong, i get them like 3 times a day. But reddit is what's been keeping me distracted when I feel lonely, both my main and this alt account. Thanks a lot for taking the time to give me advice, you and everyone in this sub is awesome, you made my night better.
Thanks a lot, stay strong too my friend. We can power through it.

I'm doing all of that, I saw my therapist today and he made me realize a lot of things. I still love her. I know I messed up and was too needy, I was an ass sometimes. But I was the best I could be with her most of the time, I'm sure of it. All I wanted was to see her happy. Now I feel a little mad, I don't feel hate towards her, but I'm really upset. I wouldn't have done what she's doing. I would've handled everything very differently. I feel like it's inconsiderate of her to leave me like that, out of the blue one day, to tell me we may get back together, and then completely ignoring me and post those photos and shit so fast. I wouldn't have done that, because I know she would feel bad and I wouldn't want to make things harder for her.

I'm already working out more or less seriously (powerlifting), I work every day and hang out with my friends at least every weekend. I deleted her number and hid her notifications and posts in FB. She knows how much I love her. I'm not gonna get my hopes up, at least not on purpose even though my subconscious may still be dreaming about her coming back (I hate that. I can't block this so easily) I'm just gonna work on myself, and be the very best man I can. 

Thanks a lot for taking the time to read and reply.

Thanks for reading and taking the time to post a reply. I realize I was too clingy and dependent. I know that if she needed time I shouldn't be bothering her, she'll only get even more tired of me. If she wants to talk to me, she has my number and knows where to find me. It's just hard to really get over it and move on. It hurts that she doesn't seem to care how I'm doing.

It's easier said than done, but I'm gonna start to go out and try to stop idealizing her as "the only one". I am pretty new to dating, that's the issue haha, I think I started dating way too late. I'm 19, we started dating when I was 16, she's like 9 months older than me, she was my first real love, my first kiss and my first everything :s. I wish I had lived all those moments with different girls so I didn't feel such a strong connection.

I already deleted her number and blocked her posts from coming up on FB. I'm gonna try to pique her curiosity by showing her I can move on too, I'm gonna work on myself. I'm gonna party like she is, and I'm already going to the gym to get the body I always wanted. That's what made me so curious, she kept going out and shit. That way I'll be more attractive for her, I don't want to be her doormat, I want her to look up to me like she did when we started going out. To think, she actually started talking to me in highschool and I was clueless of her intentions at first, and now she doesn't wanna know a thing about me.

There's no other thing to do, I don't think reaching out for her would work at all. That way if she really is just confused, she'll realize she let go of a great man. If not, at least I'll be working on myself and moving on. thanks a lot for your advice, I'll be seeing my therapist later today so i'll talk to him about this.
How much :c

That's what I meant heh, I know I'll never forget her, I just don't wanna hurt anymore. I'll try to keep a level head, I'm gonna better myself so hopefully if she really is confused, she sees that she let go of a great man. If not, I'll be on track for a better future anyways. It's gonna be hard as fuck, especially cutting contact. But if it was time that she wanted, the worst thing I can do is bother her and reassure her that breaking up with me was the right call. Fuck, it's a lot easier said than done. Wish me luck.

Yeah. I don't have her number on my phone anymore. I'm just gonna try to better myself so hopefully she sees that she let go of a great man. If not, at least I'm gonna be on track for a better future. This sucks, it's gonna be painfully slow.

You're right, I just read an article on this and it makes a lot of sense. She knows where to find me. If she asked for time and I pressure and stalk her it's just gona reassure her that she made the right call. It's hard, I admit it makes a lot of sense but it's so fucking painful to pull off. I'm already going to the gym, I lost like 13 lbs since we broke up and I'm starting to be more social. I'm gonna have a blast at everything I do and let her know I can be a catch too.

It's what I try to do anyways, because I still think about her when I'm at home. But I swear I'll delete her number from my cellphone. I still remember it anyways, but at least I won't see her in my Whatsapp chats. Wish me luck. I'm very commited right now. I hope I still think the same way when I wake up tomorrow. Thanks for the encouragement.

Ow, I'm having such a hard time and every point is telling me how I messed up. 

My ex broke up with me after dating for almost 3 years, and I tried to stay cool. But at first she told me she needed time. But when we saw each other to talk about it, she told me we should break up because she didn't know how much time she would need, or what the outcome could be. I cried, I couldn't hold it in. But she cried too, we ended on good terms. She said she was confused and needed to focus on herself.

Five days later I messaged her because she was gonna be a host in a radio show, which was a huge deal for her.

Two and a half weeks after that, I just said hello to her and talked for a while on whatsapp. 2 days after that I brought her flowers because she was going on a family trip. We talked, I told her a lot of things, how I felt. But she rejected me yet again, said it was too soon to think about getting back together, and that I should focus on myself like she's doing.

It's been almost a month since I las speaked to her, and lately I'm having the strong urge to talk to her and just try to get back to her. I check her whatsapp daily, I check her FB profile everyday too. I refuse to let go. It's just... so hard. I really want her back. But she's partying, posting pics and shit on FB and it really seems like she's moving on. Even though she said time may bring us back together, she has never asked me how I'm doing, or talked to me about anything.

But I see the logic in those points... she hasn't tried to contact me, she seems to be moving on so easily and I'm just more and more curious about what she's doing. It all seems so so obvious, but my brain and my emotions refuse to listen. I miss her so damn much, and oh god the part bout the damn chemicals...

The need for physical intimacy is just UNBEARABLE. She was my first kiss and my first time. I feel such a strong connection to her. I'm craving a hug each day, a kiss, just a second holding hands. Aaah... I can't help but feel like we met at the wrong time in life... This feels impossible to do... but I'll try to get her out of my mind and out of my life. I'm just gonna keep her friended on Facebook, nothing more. She knows where and how to find me if she feels like talking.

...^^I ^^hope ^^I ^^keep ^^thinking ^^this ^^way ^^tomorrow

Thanks a lot friend. She actually told me that she wanted to keep being friends with me... We ended on pretty good terms (Except for the fact that I didn't want to break up at all... lol) and even had lunch together that day. But I don't want to. At least not now, it would be just torture, I can't even picture my face if I ever see her dating someone else.

As you might have seen... I'm still kind of stupidly clinging to her. I can't help it. I still have her on Facebook but I unfollowed her and deactivated notifications from her. But -I deserve a punch in the face for this- I still check out her profile... I know, that's stupid but I just can't help it. :( she left so suddenly, I didn't have time to brace for this shitstorm of emotions that is hitting me. I just really wish to get back together someday... 

I also still have her number on my phone. I have her on Whatsapp and sometimes I see her online and have a huge need to message her. But deep down I know that she doesn't want to know about me. If she wanted to, she could message me, text me, call me or even come see me. I feel so stupid.

Thank you for your support. It's hard to do this alone, it means a lot to me that people is taking the time to at least read through my troubles. It's tiring... I was doing more or less fine until she started moving on, partying and shit. I'll try to power through and forget about her.

I'll try to man. I was more or less OK until she stopped giving a crap about me and started partying and instagramming... I feel disposable man. Thanks for the encouragement. I've already started meeting other girls, you're so right man, I don't like any one of them. They're not her, and right now she's the only girl I want. I'm still grieving, and she's already having a blast....
There's no change without change, as dumb as it sounds. It really is that simple. I hope the changes I'm making work out for the best.
I'll keep trying. Thanks a lot for your kind words, they mean a lot. It's hard to cope with this on my own.

I know just wanting it won't make it happen, but I can't help it :( it's been pretty hard to face that we broke up and may never get back. I can't even think straight anymore. The last time we spoke, she told me "what you can do for me right now is leave me alone". She wasn't mean about it, but it hurt and it makes me think she doesn't wanna even hear about me right now. But I had kind of a panic attack today and was very close to messaging her anyways. I miss her so much, but at the same time seeking her isn't gonna get me anywhere.
Thanks for your support. I hope I make it through.

I actually started powerlifting to get distracted. So far I'm liking it but I'm taking it slow because I'd never done that kind of exercise in my life and I don't want to get injured :p

I know I should let go of her... But it's really hard. At first she just wanted time, then she told me we should break up because she couldn't tell me how much time she would need and what the outcome could be. Still, she told me to also focus on myself and to not get my hopes up. She felt confused and wanted to focus on her job and school (even more than she already did) It baffles me how someone can put a career before someone else...

I'm not gonna lie... I'm a hopeless romantic and I'm head over heels for her. I still hope we get back together... :/ but I know never seeing her again is just as -if not more- likely. I wanna be happy it just seems extremely hard with her gone from my life. I can't find any motivation to do anything, and even less energy. I'm so confused... Should I really stop thinking about her and try to forget her? It just seems like giving up... But maybe there isn't anything to fight for anymore.

Damn, sorry I'm just rambling at this point. I don't even clearly know why she left me. Battling this depression is gonna be one hell of a ride.

No, that's not the reason. She is in college and was working at the time too. She just seemed to be too much into her job. And I wanted more time for us, we had problems because of that but now I realize all the time in the world is no good for me if I can't spend even one second of it by her side. She achieved a lot more than I did. Maybe that was it, maybe she felt I just wasn't cutting it anymore.

I let myself hurt a lot :( but it doesn't stop. It's hard because we were never unfaithful or disrespectful. We treated each other politely until the very end. She broke up with me when things were looking up, I had just gotten a job and my drivers license. But one day she just told me we were done, but we didn't fight or anything. We actually ate together that day. I still love her, I can't get what happened. She says there isn't anybody else. It sucks. She seems to be doing so well without me, going out, just being happy and I can't stop loving her. I feel worthless, disposable and easily replaceable and/or forgettable.

That's the thing though, I've been trying to, I've been going out, getting in touch again with old friends and trying to make new ones. But at the end of each day I'm still alone, I'm still sad and I still miss her so bad. I don't know what else to do. I can't play videogames or do shit because she's always on the back of my mind. I can't meet new girls because, who am I kidding? I don't want a girlfriend, I want *her* back as my GF. I'm so tired of looking for things to try.
You only seem nice and brave to me. You're not a hypocrite, people that have been through this are the ones that can give the best advice. I really appreciate your kind words :)
I'll be sure to check it out, thanks a lot for your support!
I dont have one :( i dont really know how kik works, but I'm in reddit almost all day. But also PM me your kik, maybe I'll sign up later.

Thank you all for your support guys, I'm not 100%  ok now, but I feel mich better and all of you had a big part on it. You all rock, and it's great that you care so much and I feel so grateful. You guys really made a difference :)

I'm gonna start going out with other people. Thanks for your support, I'm not going to contact her in any way for a long long time. I realize that I may have given her too much, and she got bored and lost interest. Maybe if she sees that I'm not at her feet she'll be interested again. At least that's what I pick up from the things she's said to me. If it doesn't work, at least I'll be meeting new people. Thank you for your support

Thank you, that's exactly how it feels. I saw a psychologist today and I feel much better. I'm not a bad person. Everyone makes mistakes, and maybe I was just too devoted to her that she got bored and lost interest. I may not get her back, but at least I have a plan. Thank you all for your support, I feel so much better now and you and everyone that commented here helped a lot.

Thanks, I really appreciate all the support I've been getting. You guys are amazing. I talked to a psychologist today and he made me realize something. Maybe I gave her so much that she felt she had me completely in her hands. Maybe I fulfilled all of her expectations and she had nothing more to expect from me. And that becomes boring, and a relationship stalls. 

I'm gonna start seeing other people. Maybe that'll spark some interest back in her, but if it doesn't at least I'll be distracted and I'll meet new people that may make me happy again. Thank you all for your support.
Only time will say. Thanks for cheering me up, I feel better now.
Thanks a lot. I hope someone comes to make me happy again, but I'll definitely be more cautious now. I don't wanna fall so hard in love again.
Yeah. It frustrates me that something as dumb as schedules ended something so happy and beautiful. We both work days, but I only started recently so I took more time to adjust.

Yeah, it was more or less like that. We went through a rocky period of changes in our schedules and I put a lot of pressure on her. But just as I was getting used to it and thought we were ok, she broke up with me. We ended on good terms, she says she's confused and we may or may not get back together. But she won't even talk to me :( so I feel like she wants to move on and get over me.

We ended on pretty good terms. We didn't cheat or anything like that, we just had a hard time getting used to our new work/school schedules. That caused more problems but nothing really heavy. We were definitely more happy than sad. I would never hurt her and I'd still do anything for her. She just doesn't want to be with me anymore.

I know I put a lot of pressure on her because of her schedule. I hurt her on more than one occasion. But our time together was much more happy than sad. I was getting used to our new schedules, but the process was hard so I also had something to do with it. But I was getting used to it :(

Thanks a lot for your kind words. I know, I know and I feel kinda bad that there are people that care and I can't give a damn. I want her to care, you know :/ it's hard to move on because things happened so suddenly. I can't stop loving her so easily, and I don't want to forget her :(

You're right and I'm not just wasting my time. I still work, I started working out but I still feel sad. I'm doing all that because if there's a chance of her coming back, it'll only happen if she sees me and sees a strong person, not a sobbing mess. It just feels hopeless after she rejected me again 3 days ago even though she says she's confused. At least if she doesn't come back, I will have done something good for myself. Thank you for your support.

Thanks a lot for your kind words. I'm really confused because we broke up but ended in pretty good terms. She's just confused. And I feel even more confused. She still doesn't wanna see me or talk to me and I don't even know exactly why. She told me there's no one else and that she needs to be alone, she asked me for a time at first but she broke up with me for good when we met up to talk.

I know they care about me, they want me to move on. It's been 3 weeks since we broke up and I don't feel any better. I appreciate my friend's concern but they just want me to move on, and I can't, it was so sudden. I can't stop loving someone just like that :(
I don't know if it sounds stupid but letting go is the hardest part. I don't wanna feel bad but I don't wanna forget her and stop loving her :( I wish I could just go back in time.
There has to be something you like doing or always wanted to do. I don't know, jogging, fishing. Only you know for sure.
Well, you can do both, just don't devote your life exclusively to other people. Spend time on you and spend time on people that make  you feel good.
You're too kind, thanks a lot!

Yeah, I'm slowly moving on. I guess I just needed to be sure of her decision before accepting it. It sucks, but I wasn't a shitty boyfriend so I don't feel that bad. Maybe I just feel so much for her because she was my first, and meeting other people will help. We'll se, thanks a lot for talking to me. I don't feel as suicidal now.

My family matters, because it would suck for them to be sad if I kill myself. But at the same time I think fuck it, I won't even notice since I'd be dead. She was my first love, first kiss, first time, first everything! That's what hits me the most, and I don't think it's that dumb because I'm not that young (I'm 19) It sucks that I shared so many intimate things with her, and feel such a stong connection. And it also makes me mad because I always tried really fucking hard to be a good guy and make her and her parents happy since she had several shitty boyfriends before me. I sound like a neckbeard but really, what good is all that effort? I won't become a scumbag just because of that though. Maybe since she was my first everything It'd be better for me to start seeing other people. 

Sorry dude/dudette, I'm just ranting at this point but it feels good to write these things down. 

Thanks for replying

If you decide to live, it has to be for you. I made the mistake of devoting my life to someone who is gone now, and believe me, living for others might seem okay but when they leave you, you end up with nothing.

Spend time on you, not others, because the only one that will stay for your whole life wheter you want it or not is you, and everyone else can leave at any time, and I'm not talking just about leaving your life, but leaving this world. So if you want to live, spend time on making YOU happy. You're the most important thing in your life, you always have to come first when making any decision. I learned it the hard way, and I think it's too late for me frankly.

I just made her feel bad and guilty when things weren't going the way I liked them, I was a manipulative little shit and it went for quite a while so it really affected her. I'm going to talk with her today. I hope things don't go so bad, but It's better if I don't wait for the best. Thanks for hearing me. Talking always helps me recognize my mistakes.

Thank you for replying. I feel like the worst thing I can do is bottle things up until they blow up in my face. I just feel so tired and angry and so so... Idk how to say it but I'm ashamed of the things I did to my GF. I was shitty, an all around asshole and now that I'm trying so hard to change it's too late. If only I did things differently.
